about: Golden corpus for rider name matching (resolve_rider in Velogames.jl, vgleague.matching in vgleague). Each case is a printed name that did not match its reference set by key, from a measured join across the 2023-26 archive; 'field' names the reference set, stored as printed names whose keys are createkey(name). 'method' and 'expected' are what the resolver must return ('expected' is the reference rider's printed name, null when unresolved; 'candidates' lists an ambiguous case's riders). 'verdict' is the review label and 'old_ladder' what the pre-v2 ladder did (right, wrong or none), kept for the record and not checked. A case with 'frame' is resolved together with those other printed names of its source: a rematch may not take a rider another row of the frame matches exactly ('collides_exact', with that rider as the candidate).
